value.hook: Open when a real-tmux test loses its server in CI but not locally, or before changing control-client attach/exit or _pij handling
value.title: tmux flakes: reproduce on CI's tmux version, read the server log, measure before believing a fix

sections.name: body
sections.value:
F237/F238 lessons (tmux control-client crashes):
- CI runs ubuntu-24.04 = tmux 3.4; local is Homebrew 3.6a. A CI-only tmux flake: build that version from the release tarball (configure needs --enable-utf8proc plus Homebrew libevent/ncurses/utf8proc on PKG_CONFIG_PATH, about 20 s) and put it first on PATH for the test binary.
- Loop the built test binary directly (nice -n 19, 8 parallel, 2000 runs) and count failures AND new ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/tmux-*.ips. A crash can land in teardown without failing the test. Crash reports give the stack.
- A wrapper `tmux` on PATH that adds -vv gives a server log, but the logging slows tmux enough to hide races (0/600). Use it once to learn the sequence, never for rates.
- Mechanism found: a control client marked dead but not yet lost does not count as attached, so destroy-unattached destroys _pij under it, and its client-detached notify derefs a NULL curw (SIGSEGV server_client_get_pane). ONE exit suffices. Serializing exits did not fix it (13/2000); destroy-unattached off, or a teardown over the live pipe (kill an alone _pij, else switch it off), did (0/2000).
- Measure the proposed fix before reporting it: my first draft claimed 0/1000 for serial drops, and the run said otherwise. Report the shape change to the PM with numbers.
- testkit's arch_drift pins external deps per crate (ratified graph). Put syscalls like getuid in pij-core (already allowed nix), not in pij-tmux.
- just bounce-rs used SIGTERM, which the daemon did not handle (no Drop ran). pij-rs daemon bounce uses SIGINT and waits.
